bindings.caption: Stir the 10 mL precursor mixture under nitrogen flow at 120 °C for 1 h. Initial mixture uses 0.2 mmol Cd oleate, 0.6 mmol HDA and 0.8 mmol OA. Vessel dimensions and geometry are not reported for this operation.
bindings.source_locator: SI PDF p.19, S5.1 bimodal experimental method

bindings.caption: Stop nitrogen flow and inject 2 mL of 1 M TOP-Se. S5.1 injection temperature is X+15 °C and growth temperature X. The initial Cd:Se molar ratio is 1:10. No numerical injection rate is supplied. Vessel dimensions and geometry are not reported for this operation.
bindings.source_locator: SI PDF p.19, S5.1 bimodal experimental method

bindings.caption: Stabilize the reaction at 270 °C. No final stop, cooling, washing or analytical dilution details are independently supplied for S5. Vessel dimensions and geometry are not reported for this operation.

bindings.caption: After 4 min, inject an additional 0.4 mmol of cadmium oleate. Second stock solvent composition and delivered volume are not specified by the method. Figure S5.2 analysis annotates total V=14 mL for the 230 °C run; this is not used to invent a separately reported stock dose. Vessel dimensions and geometry are not reported for this operation.
bindings.source_locator: SI PDF p.19, S5.1 bimodal experimental method

bindings.caption: Take timed aliquots and acquire absorption and photoluminescence. Source spectra and same-color optical pairs are retained; exact excitation wavelength, aliquot volume and purification are unreported. For two-population analysis, PL maxima are calibrated to absorption maxima and then to radius using published SAXS sizing. Vessel dimensions and geometry are not reported for this operation.

general_background.title: Thermodynamics and kinetics
general_background.summary: Thermodynamics describes which states are energetically favoured, while kinetics governs how quickly a system can move between them. A change can be favourable yet proceed slowly when an activation barrier or limited transport restricts the pathway.
